creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc revisits Palo Alto Networks after its fall from $400 to about $353 and concludes it is still not a buying opportunity, keeping it a hold. Cybersecurity stocks are up almost 100% in 2026 and Palo Alto over 91%, and he notes he downgraded the group to hold a couple of months ago, which proved correct as the shares turned volatile. The agentic AI boom has lifted Wall Street's long-term EPS growth estimates for Palo Alto from 12% earlier this year to 19%, since agents taking more actions creates more risk and more need for security. But the valuation has already absorbed that: the forward P/E is 72 against sub-20% EPS growth, and his discounted cash flow model still says the stock is overvalued at $352. He also thinks the market is pricing in consumer-side agentic AI catalysts, such as Meta's Muse, before any results have appeared. He last reviewed the name on 29 September with the same conclusion. Call: PANW HOLD, a stance flip from AVOID on 4 October (he had already moved it to hold a couple of months ago; this video confirms the hold at the lower price).
